name: fonts-arcade
title: Gamestage fonts, arcade
description: Unbounded for the numbers and actions a player tracks, DM Sans for interface text, self-hosted. The arcade theme names Unbounded as its display family; this item is what puts it on the page. It declares the same two faces as @gamestage/fonts and depends on that item for the files rather than shipping a second copy of them. No request leaves for a third-party origin (GSUI-149). Installed for you by @gamestage/theme-arcade.
docs: Import gamestage-fonts-arcade.css once at the root, before gamestage-tokens.css, in place of gamestage-fonts.css. It declares the same two faces the base pairing does, because arcade uses the same two, and the files come from @gamestage/fonts rather than from here: one copy on disk, not two. A theme can name any family it likes, because the families are tokens; what it cannot do is load one, and a theme whose family is not loaded falls through its stack in silence and looks like a theme that changed nothing. The licences, the versions and where each file came from are in packages/tokens/gamestage-fonts/README.md, and each OFL.txt ships beside the faces because the licence has to travel with them.
